review:
A Day of the Dead carnival on 5x3 and 10 lines, with maracas, calaveras and vihuelas. The wild doubles every win it helps make.

Three scatters pay and give 15 free spins with every win tripled, and retriggers are unlimited – so a wild win in the bonus pays 6x. High volatility, a 4,684x max and 96.16% RTP, with free spins roughly once every 156 spins. Like Lady Wolf Moon, but swingier.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
